segment.text: We store personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which the data has been collected, and in accordance with our internal record retention schedule. We may not accept a request to erase your personal data where we require it to comply with a legal obligation or in relation to a legal claim. Requests to exercise your rights should be addressed to privacy@yale.co.uk or to our Customer Support Team. If you have a complaint regarding our processing of your personal data you are entitled to report this to the ICO (Information Commissioner's Office) at ico.org.uk or to the supervisory authority where you live or work if different, list of which can be found at ec.europa.eu.

When you download the App and in order to use the Services, we require you to establish an account and collect and store the following: Your name, email, password, telephone number, Product ID and user verification identifiers. Personal Data collected based on your use of the Services. We collect personal data that you may provide about yourself, such as user-name, as well as personal data about other people who have access to your Products, such as other family members, guests, service providers like gardeners, house cleaners and/or others ("Invitees"). For example, you may include email addresses and telephone numbers of Invitees who you are allowing to access your Products. We may ask for access to your contact list and you may consent to providing access to such list which includes personal data. We collect personal data that you may include in help requests, customer service correspondence and/or in any feedback you send to us. We also collect personal data included in messages that you may send from within the App whether those messages are sent to us, an Invitee or a third party. If you enable the Auto-Unlock feature, the App will request your consent in order to track your location in order to determine when your App nears Products that you have permission to access (e.g. when you are near home). Location information will only be stored on your device, and not on our servers. This information will tell your mobile device to start listening for your lock more often (increasing the polling). This improves the device's performance and saves your mobile device's battery life. Personal Data we automatically collect. When you use the App, we will create a user ID. In addition, we also gather the following information for purposes of providing the Services when you download the App and/or access the Services: usage data about how and when you interact with the Services, Product status, logs of those who lock/unlock your Products, the people that you invite to use the Services and Product, and those people who may invite you to use their products. We also collect the following information about the devices on which the App is downloaded and the Products you use: operating system of the device on which the App is downloaded (e.g. you, Guests), the version of the App on such devices, information about your Products, including serial numbers, MAC address, software versions on such Products and installation dates. Personal Data we receive when you use third party products and services. If you access the Services through a third-party (e.g. by managing your device via your television remote or connecting your device to your home security system), use a third-party applications or services through the "Works With" feature, otherwise use a third party service provider in connection with the Services and Products, or request or authorize us to give access or data to a third-party service provider (e.g. a delivery service, property management or rental service), then that third party will send data about you and your Invitees, such as User ID. We will transfer personal data for the purposes set out in the section entitled "how we use that information and why"; To August Home, Inc. who is responsible for the processing of your personal data and who in turn may engage third parties to perform functions necessary for us to provide the following for the Services: hosting, development, maintenance, billing services, mobile application functionality, facilitate communications, enable customer support and any features or functionality available as part of the Services, provided only to the extent necessary to provide the Services. August Home and any third-party service providers may only use your personal data in accordance with our instructions. To your Invitees when you invite them to access your Products. For example, if you invite a guest to access your Products, then we will share certain elements of your information with them, such as your name, in order for your guest to understand the invite and access the Product. To third parties that you choose when you use the "Works With" feature of the Services to connect your Products with such third party products or services. Digital Analytics providers who provide tools that help us improve your experience. These service providers may only use your personal data in accordance with our instructions. To a buyer or a potential future buyer of our business. As required by law
